name_input: AVIATION OVERSEAS SUPPLY LOGISTICS PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey free view, company page (slug: aviation-overseas-supply-logistics-private-limited): "Total Shipments 1137 Records detected / Trading Partners 43 / Ports 36 / Latest Cargo 2026-02-25". The dated rows actually rendered (5 of 1137) are all INBOUND: e.g. "2026-02-25 | AVIOPARTS S.L.U | AVIATION OVERSEAS SUPPLY LOGISTICS PRIVATE LIMITED | MC780B2_KIT130 NAFTOSEAL, FUSELAGE FUEL TANK SEALANT, TECHKIT 130 ML ... | BARCELONA, FRANCE | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 32149090 | BOL 7746281". No dated outbound export B/L row was visible. Indirect export signal only, from the same page's 'Buyers' block: "53 HELI BHUTAN PVT LTD ... P O BOX 1175 THIMPHU BHUTAN", "35 DRUK AIR CORPORATION LTD ... PARO INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (PB H) PARO BHUTAN", "34 GULF HELICOPTERS COMPANY ... DOHA,QATAR", "25 THE HELICOPTER AND JET COMPANY ... RIYADH 13456 SAUDI ARABIA" — these are counterparty aggregates with no date, destination-specific HS code or B/L number attached.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split found in any accessible source. Search engine (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned 'Connection refused' on all queries, so no domestic-supply page could be located. volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on free views. Not public in the sources reachable — recorded as null, not estimated.
note: Direction of trade must be read carefully: the 1137 ImportKey records are IMPORTS INTO INDIA (Delhi Air Cargo ACC, foreign supplier -> this Indian buyer), not exports. The declared HS 321490 (mastics/sealants) does appear in the actual customs record — row of 2026-02-25, HS 32149090, NAFTOSEAL fuselage fuel tank sealant — so the HS code is factually consistent with a real shipment line, though the company's trade is overwhelmingly aircraft parts and fluids (73181600 screws, 34039900 gearbox oil, 38190090 hydraulic fluid, 85392990 lamps). Export status is 'declared_only' rather than 'confirmed' because the free view shows only counterparty aggregates (Bhutan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia) without a single dated export B/L, HS code or destination line; the site's own wording is 'Shipment records indicate the products being imported and exported' — a platform claim, not a record. Domestic supply: no traces found in reachable sources; this is a genuine gap, not a negative finding. Role is clearly a trader/distributor of aviation consumables (buys from Avioparts S.L.U, Proponent Inc, Sky Mart Sales Corp, Airtech Advanced Materials UK), not a manufacturer. Source counter: ImportKey reported 1137 total shipments; 5 dated rows were actually rendered in the free view (all inbound), 0 outbound rows seen.
